tasks.label: Frontend: Start dev server
tasks.detail: Nuxt のローカル開発サーバーを起動します。

tasks.label: Frontend: Stop dev server
tasks.detail: Nuxt のローカル開発サーバーを停止します。
args: $targets = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^node(.exe)?$' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'nuxt dev --dotenv \.env\.local' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'pulllog\\frontend' }; if ($targets) { $targets | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force }; Write-Host ('Stopped frontend dev server: ' + (($targets | ForEach-Object { $_.ProcessId }) -join ', ')) } else { Write-Host 'No frontend dev server process found.' }

tasks.label: Frontend: Open local app
tasks.detail: 起動済みのローカルアプリをブラウザで開きます。
args: $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(90); $frontendReady = $false; $backendReady = $false; while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { $frontendReady = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName '127.0.0.1' -Port 4649 -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3030/api/v1/dummy' -TimeoutSec 2; $backendReady = $response.StatusCode -eq 200 } catch { $backendReady = $false }; if ($frontendReady -and $backendReady) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; if (-not ($frontendReady -and $backendReady)) { Write-Error 'Frontend or backend did not become ready within 90 seconds.'; exit 1 }; $targetUrl = 'https://localhost:4649'; try { [void][System.Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses('pull.log'); $targetUrl = 'https://pull.log:4649' } catch {}; Start-Process $targetUrl; Write-Host ('Opened ' + $targetUrl)

tasks.label: Local: Start app stack and open browser
tasks.detail: バックエンド起動 → フロントエンド起動 → ブラウザ起動を順番に実行します。
args: $backendPath = (Resolve-Path '${workspaceFolder}/../backend/stable').Path; $frontendPath = (Resolve-Path '${workspaceFolder}').Path; if (-not (Test-NetConnection -ComputerName '127.0.0.1' -Port 3030 -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit','-Command',"Set-Location '$backendPath'; php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=3030" }; $backendReady = $false; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(90); while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3030/api/v1/dummy' -TimeoutSec 2; if ($response.StatusCode -eq 200) { $backendReady = $true; break } } catch {}; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; if (-not $backendReady) { Write-Error 'Backend did not become ready on http://127.0.0.1:3030 within 90 seconds.'; exit 1 }; if (-not (Test-NetConnection -ComputerName '127.0.0.1' -Port 4649 -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit','-Command',"Set-Location '$frontendPath'; pnpm dev" }; $frontendReady = $false; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(120); while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { if (Test-NetConnection -ComputerName '127.0.0.1' -Port 4649 -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue) { $frontendReady = $true; break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; if (-not $frontendReady) { Write-Error 'Frontend did not become ready on port 4649 within 120 seconds.'; exit 1 }; $targetUrl = 'https://localhost:4649'; try { [void][System.Net.Dns]::GetHostAddresses('pull.log'); $targetUrl = 'https://pull.log:4649' } catch {}; Start-Process $targetUrl; Write-Host ('Opened ' + $targetUrl)

tasks.label: Frontend E2E Lane: Start unified stack
tasks.detail: frontend/backend を local-e2e で同時起動します。既に両方が健全ならスキップし、不整合時は対象ポートを解放して再起動します。
args: $backendPath = (Resolve-Path '${workspaceFolder}/../backend/stable').Path; $frontendPath = (Resolve-Path '${workspaceFolder}').Path; function Test-BackendReady { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3030/api/v1/dummy' -TimeoutSec 2; return $response.StatusCode -eq 200 } catch { return $false } }; $frontendReady = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName '127.0.0.1' -Port 43173 -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; $backendReady = Test-BackendReady; if ($frontendReady -and $backendReady) { Write-Host 'E2E unified lane is already running. Skip startup.'; exit 0 }; $portOwners = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 3030, 43173 } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($portOwners) { $portOwners | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host ('Freed port owner PID(s): ' + ($portOwners -join ', ')) }; Start-Process powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -WorkingDirectory $backendPath -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-Command','composer run e2e:serve'; Start-Process powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -WorkingDirectory $frontendPath -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-Command','pnpm exec cross-env NUXT_TYPESCRIPT_CHECK=false nuxt dev --dotenv .env.e2e --host 127.0.0.1 --port 43173'; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(150); $frontendReady = $false; $backendReady = $false; while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { $frontendReady = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName '127.0.0.1' -Port 43173 -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; $backendReady = Test-BackendReady; if ($frontendReady -and $backendReady) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; if (-not ($frontendReady -and $backendReady)) { Write-Error 'E2E unified lane startup failed: frontend/backend did not become ready in time.'; exit 1 }; Write-Host 'E2E unified lane is ready (frontend:43173, backend:3030).'

tasks.label: Frontend E2E Lane: Stop unified stack
tasks.detail: local-e2e で利用する frontend/backend の起動プロセスを停止します。
args: $stopped = @(); $portOwners = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 3030, 43173 } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($portOwners) { $portOwners | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $stopped += $_ } }; $targets = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { ($_.Name -match '^node(.exe)?$' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'nuxt dev --dotenv \.env\.e2e' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'pulllog\\frontend') -or ($_.Name -match '^php(.exe)?$' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'artisan serve --env=e2e --host=127.0.0.1 --port=3030' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'pulllog\\backend\\stable') }; if ($targets) { $targets | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $stopped += $_.ProcessId } }; $stopped = $stopped | Sort-Object -Unique; if ($stopped.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host ('Stopped PID(s): ' + ($stopped -join ', ')) } else { Write-Host 'No unified e2e lane processes were found.' }

tasks.label: Frontend E2E Lane: Restart unified stack
tasks.detail: local-e2e の frontend/backend を停止してから再起動します。
dependsOn: Frontend E2E Lane: Stop unified stack
Frontend E2E Lane: Start unified stack
